game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stones value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about stones to power up the forest ranger and open the herb garden.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Druid Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Druid Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
